answer: Make every newcomer cross a dune of waystations before it can trade: at each station it does a small verified job and earns a copper stamp, and the stamps are braided into one vine of provenance bound to a single key. A vine is valid only when its stamps come from three unrelated stations that never repeat signers, so a duplicate shows a thin or copied braid and is cut. Standing grows only as the vine lengthens with fresh stamps, and idle vines wither. Sybil farms must fund a copper stamp, redo real work, and pass fresh stations for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
